articles.summary: At Automate 2026 in Chicago, the Nasdaq-listed company launches RoboShare — a matchmaking platform for robot rentals — introduces AIXC01, an infrastructure network for autonomous assets, and sets out a framework designed to extend a robot's productive life well beyond the point of sale.
articles.title: AIxCrypto Debuts at Automate 2026, Unveiling Its EAI + Web3 Robot Ecosystem Strategy with the Launch of RoboShare and AIXC01
